name: lremovexattr
description: lremovexattr removes an extended attribute identified by name from the specified path. It is identical to removexattr except that for symbolic links, it removes the attribute from the link itself rather than the target file.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the file or symbolic link from which to remove the extended attribute.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the extended attribute to remove, including its namespace prefix.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The named attribute does not exist.
Extended attributes are not supported by the filesystem, or are disabled.
